product.name: Boombah Sublimated Custom Football Uniforms
product.description: Boombah Sublimated football uniforms use high quality fabric that is fully sublimated to give you a great fit and feel with bold and vibrant colors that won't wear off. Boombah Ink football uniforms have everything from classic looks to more cutting edge designs to ensure your team looks the best on the field. Orders having less than 10 garments are subject to a minimum order fee of $25.
product.leadTime: Mockup Lead Time: 2-4 business days after order is placed. Ships: 2 weeks after artwork approval.
